name: How can I keep construction dust, noise, and mess under control during a home addition?

mainEntity.name: How can I keep construction dust, noise, and mess under control during a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Dust and noise can’t be eliminated, but they can be significantly managed with good planning and protective measures. You and your contractor should agree on logistics before work starts.

Lack of dust control and chaotic work habits are among the top homeowner complaints. Simple but consistent routines make a big difference in livability during construction.

Key factors:
- Temporary walls, plastic barriers, and zipper doors
- Floor protection, daily sweeping, and debris removal
- Work hours policies and tool noise expectations
- Protecting HVAC systems and valuables from dust

Before signing, ask your contractor exactly how they handle dust control and cleanliness on additions. Request it be written into the contract or job rules, including daily cleanup and designated material areas. A professional crew will have a standard approach and be willing to tailor it slightly to your household’s needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can’t avoid all dust and noise, but you can reduce them with temporary barriers, floor protection, HVAC protection, defined work hours, and daily cleanup. Discuss these details with your contractor upfront and include dust‑control and cleanliness expectations in your written agreement.
